footprint_units.density_formula: rho_d = (p - e) / (R_d T), e = q p / (0.622 + 0.378 q), R_d = 287.05 J kg-1 K-1; p = p_s exp(-g z / (R_d Tv(z/2))), Tv = T (1 + 0.6077 q); T, q, p_s interpolated to the particle in the step's met window and time weight
footprint_units.notes: Raw residence-time accumulator; downstream code is responsible for converting to a physical sensitivity (e.g. ppm per emission flux), which requires cell volume, mixed-layer thickness, air density, and molar-mass conversions. See Lin et al. 2003 (STILT) or Seibert & Frank 2004 for standard recipes.
footprint_units.particle_weight_convention: 1/n_particles for uniform releases; each particle represents 1/N of the total released mass
footprint_units.to_surface_sensitivity: M_air / h x (sum over the 0-h m layer) gives m2 s mol-1 of dry air (M_air = 0.02897 kg mol-1); apply no further density
footprint_units.units_long: particle weight x residence seconds / dry-air density at the particle (s m3 kg-1 of dry air per unit released mass)
footprint_units.value: Σ over active particles in cell of (weight_i × dt_step_seconds / rho_d,i), rho_d,i the dry-air density at particle i as it is counted
footprint_units.value_dimensionality: (dimensionless mass fraction) × s m3 kg-1 — residence time per unit released mass, divided by the dry-air density

met_stores.compression: lossless: Blosc zstd level 5 with byte shuffle on float32 (Zarr v3); no scale/offset, no bit-rounding
met_stores.processing: (1) Read anonymously from ARCO ERA5 on Google Cloud Storage: 3-D fields from the model-level store, surface fields from the unified pressure-level/surface store. | (2) Cropped to the ERA5 grid points inside the domain box (edges included). Latitude kept north to south as in ARCO; longitude kept in 0..360 unless the box crosses 0 E, then given in -180..180 and ascending. | (3) u_component_of_wind, v_component_of_wind, vertical_velocity (omega, Pa s-1), temperature, specific_humidity, geopotential (time-varying), boundary_layer_height, surface_pressure, geopotential_at_surface: unchanged. | (4) surface_sensible_heat_flux: ERA5's accumulation over the hour ending at the timestamp (J m-2, positive down), unchanged; labelled cell_methods 'time: sum', glide_period_seconds 3600. | (5) friction_velocity = sqrt(|tau|/rho), not ERA5's zust: tau = hypot(ewss, nsss) / 3600 s, the mean surface stress over the hour ending at the timestamp; rho = surface_pressure / (287.05 * T * (1 + 0.6077 q)) with T, q on the lowest model level (hybrid 137) at the timestamp. Labelled cell_methods 'time: mean', glide_period_seconds 3600. | (6) Computed in float64 where derived, stored as float32. No interpolation in time or space. | (7) repair era5-surface-geopotential, met-bazarr 0.4.0: geopotential_at_surface replaced by geopotential at hybrid 137 - alpha * 287.0597 * T * (1 + 0.6078 q) at hybrid 137 (alpha = 1 - b/(1-b) ln(1/b), b = 0.997630), so the surface lies under the model levels (met-bazarr decision 0009)
